claims: The Michigan Wolverines won the 2026 NCAA men's basketball National Championship.
The Michigan Wolverines defeated UConn 69-63 in Indianapolis.
The Michigan Wolverines were led by Elliot Cadeau and Coach Dusty May.
The victory marked Michigan's second NCAA title in program history.
The victory was Michigan's first NCAA title since 1989.
The Michigan Wolverines had a 37-3 season
